zh: 欢迎来到 DentalVista，自由动脉推出的可交互三维口腔解剖教学平台。
en: Welcome to DentalVista, FreedomAI's interactive 3D oral anatomy platform.

zh: 进入三维口腔，牙齿从颌骨中依次萌出，整个口腔在你眼前展开。
en: Enter the 3D mouth: the teeth erupt one by one and the whole mouth unfolds.

zh: 模型包含 52 颗牙齿、颌骨、牙龈、腭与舌、神经血管和唾液腺，共 94 个结构，全部按真实毫米尺寸建模。
en: 52 teeth, jaws, gingiva, palate and tongue, nerves, vessels and salivary glands: 94 structures, all in true millimetres.

zh: 在口腔结构面板里，每个系统都可以设为实体、半透明、线框或隐藏，一层一层看清内部。
en: Every system can be solid, translucent, wireframe or hidden, so you can peel the mouth layer by layer.

zh: 点击任意结构，右侧显示中英双语知识卡：FDI 牙位、萌出年龄、牙根与根管、临床要点，还可以一键向 DentalGPT 提问。
en: Click any structure for a bilingual knowledge card: FDI code, eruption age, roots and canals, clinical points, and a one-click question to DentalGPT.

zh: 剖面工具可以沿矢状、冠状或水平面切开模型，切面以实体显示，釉质、牙本质、牙髓一目了然。
en: The section tool cuts along any plane with solid caps: enamel, dentine and pulp at a glance.

zh: 口腔律动里的萌出时间轴，从出生演示到二十二岁：乳牙萌出、替牙期、恒牙列完成。
en: The eruption timeline runs from birth to 22: primary teeth, mixed dentition, full permanent dentition.

zh: 龋病进展演示了 36 牙从釉质白垩斑、龋洞、牙本质龋，到牙髓炎和根尖周脓肿的全过程。
en: Caries progression on tooth 36: white spot, cavity, dentine caries, pulpitis and periapical abscess.

zh: 咀嚼动画展示下颌绕髁突的转动与滑动；把颌骨调成半透明，下牙槽神经与血管的走行清晰可见。
en: Chewing shows the mandible rotating and gliding on the condyles; with the bone translucent, the inferior alveolar nerve and vessels are clear.

zh: 八条教学路线把镜头、图层和剖面串成分步课程，例如下牙槽神经阻滞麻醉的解剖。
en: Eight guided lessons chain camera, layers and sections into step-by-step courses, such as the anatomy of the inferior alveolar nerve block.

zh: 解剖挑战用主动回忆巩固记忆：结构识别、解剖寻找、FDI 编号，每轮五题。
en: The anatomy challenge uses active recall: identify, locate, FDI numbering, five questions a round.

zh: DentalVista，让口腔解剖看得见、摸得着。自由动脉，与你一起守护全世界的笑容。
en: DentalVista makes oral anatomy visible and tangible. FreedomAI, protecting every smile on Earth.
